claims: 0vbb half-life combines multiple LNV mechanisms, phase-space factors and specific NMEs.
Closure approximation in 0vbb can be evaluated efficiently via a single Lanczos iteration using isospin projection without computing full TBTDs.
Optimal closure energies are Hamiltonian-specific, with CMU and Strasbourg-Madrid groups adopting distinct optimal values.
2vbb doorway-state Lanczos algorithm speeds up intermediate-state summation by a factor of approximately 1000 over direct diagonalization.
gA quenching factor of ~0.6-0.74 is required for 2vbb Gamow-Teller decay but is not applied to high-momentum-transfer 0vbb operators.
